title: Explicit exact geometric stalk on the coefficient-sized etale model
statement: For a scheme X, a commutative coefficient ring B in max(v,u+1), and a geometric point x of X, define the module stalk by constant-scalar restriction on [def-pe-etale-constructible-module], precomposition along AsSmall.up, and the usual pointed-etale-neighborhood colimit at x. This functor is additive and exact. Define its derived functor on the standard constant-module derived category by exact localization, with values in the small Grothendieck derived category of B-modules. All data are explicit functor composites.

proof.text: The literal fixed-scalar functor is an equivalence, as proved in the coefficient-comparison module. Precomposition with the site equivalence is an equivalence. Both are additive and exact.
